title: Simple Habits Many Doctors Suggest for Better Sleep

content: General sleep guidance from health organisations is fairly consistent. Keeping a regular sleep and wake time, even on weekends, helps the body clock settle.
Many experts also suggest keeping the bedroom dark, quiet and cool, limiting caffeine later in the day, and reducing bright screens in the hour before bed.
This article is general information, not medical advice. If you have long-lasting trouble sleeping, loud snoring with pauses in breathing, or daytime exhaustion, speak to a doctor.
